title: Bug: Dell new platform Z9864 commit causes all broadcom platforms bootup with the wrong "sonic-platform" package
author: mlok-nokia
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Dell new platform PR  https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26001 " [Dell] Z9864F initial commit #26001" use the "pip3 install /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-dell_z9864f-r0/sonic_platform-1.0-py3-none-any.whl --force-reinstall -q --root-user-action=ignore " in the .postinst.  During broadcom image build, all debs will be dpkg -i  (install) and dpkg -p (remove) due to dependency.  "pip3 install" will install the wheel to a location which dpkg doesn't known (/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/sonic-platform in this case).  dpkg -g will not able to remove it before building .bin and /usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/sonic-platform will be packaged to sonic-broadcom.bin

When an image installed and bootup, a correct platform vendor's "sonic-platform" will be installed in /usr/lib/python3/dist-package directory.  Now, on localhost, both /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/sonic-platform (correct) and /usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packaes/sonic-platform (Dell Z9864) exist.  Any "import sonic_platform" in localhost script will use Dell's Z9864 sonic-platform package and device is running a wrong sonic-platform package in localhost.


 

### Steps to Reproduce

On Pizza box, install a latest image and execute "show platform firmware  status" will fail

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Device should be up and running fine after image installed.

linkedPullRequests.title: [platform] Avoid installing Z9864 platform API in postinst
linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/27104.

The Z9864f platform package currently runs `pip3 install .../sonic_platform-1.0-py3-none-any.whl` from its Debian `postinst`. During broadcom image construction, platform packages for many SKUs are installed/removed as build dependencies. That direct pip install writes `sonic_platform` into `/usr/local/lib/python*/dist-packages`, outside dpkg ownership, so removing the Debian package does not clean it up. The leftover Z9864f `sonic_platform` can then be packaged into non-Z9864 broadcom images and shadow the correct platform API at runtime.

The Z9864f platform init script already installs the matching platform API from `DEVICE_METADATA.localhost.platform`, following the existing Dell platform pattern. This change removes the unconditional `postinst` pip install so the API is installed only by the runtime platform path.

#### How I verified it
- `bash -n platform/broadcom/sonic-platform-modules-dell/debian/platform-modules-z9864f.postinst`
- Confirmed `z9864f_platform.sh` still contains the runtime `install_python_api_package()` path and calls it during platform init.
- Confirmed no direct `pip3 install ...sonic_platform` remains in the Z9864f `postinst`.
